remarks: Welcome to this beautifully refreshed, move-in ready condo in one of Canyon Country’s most inviting communities. Enjoy a lifestyle packed with amenities such as  playgrounds, dog parks, sparkling pools, and peaceful greenbelts all just steps from your front door. Inside, the home shines with new paint, new flooring, and updated bathrooms that bring a modern, clean feel throughout. The layout is bright, comfortable, and instantly welcoming. Major systems are already handled for you the HVAC was replaced in 2022, giving you peace of mind from day one. This is the kind of home buyers love: updated, low-maintenance, and ready for its next owner    Cameras are on property
